answer: Reputation decays exponentially, losing half its weight each configured temporal half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained, reciprocal honest service. In EigenTrust, a freshly spawned sybil has almost no trusted incoming mass and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; multiplying such identities cannot create credible transitive support or pass consensus thresholds. The ocean of aliases remains beyond the horizon until verified behavior carries a node toward the zenith of trust.
